answer.explanation: The visible events show normal behaviour: every invocation has a matching END and REPORT, with no errors, timeouts, throttling or access-denied messages. Durations stay under 700 ms, far below any plausible timeout. Max memory used is 95-110 MB against configured sizes of 256 MB and 1024 MB, so memory is over-provisioned for CompressionFunction and ThumbnailerFunction, but this is consistent across the window and is a cost concern rather than a configuration fault. About 3,800 events are truncated, so the conclusion covers only the visible portion of the window.
